svg.title: Modified Gram-Schmidt preserves orthogonality better on nearly dependent columns
svg.desc: The left panel shows orthogonality defects as the condition number grows. The right panel compares Gram matrix error heatmaps at epsilon ten to the minus seven.
svg.text: Same QR identity, very different numerical orthogonality
